Domain of unknown function (DUF8108) central domain

family.description: This entry represents a the central transmembrane domain from family of uncharacterised proteins from halophilic archaea. The family is predominantly found in the class Halobacteria, which includes members from the families Natrialbaceae and Haloferacaceae. Proteins in this family are typically between 150 and 350 amino acids in length. They are predicted to be membrane-associated, as suggested by the presence of two transmembrane helices represented by this domain.
